author: nanouai
title: Chase a reply for me
blurb: Refunds, warranty claims, landlords: nanou nudges you when an answer is late.
sample: The shop hasn't answered about your refund in 9 days. Shall I draft a nudge?
firstMessage: Look through my mail for things I'm still waiting on a reply to (refunds, warranty claims, a shop, a landlord). List them with how long each has been waiting, and nudge me when one is overdue.
